{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans applaud President Bush and the Republican Congress for honoring the United States' promises to the people of Taiwan.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Taiwan is a longstanding friend of the United States and a genuine democracy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Taiwan deserves the United States' strong support, including the timely sale of defensive arms to enhance Taiwan's security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans applaud Taiwan's membership in the World Trade Organization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support Taiwan's participation in the World Health Organization and other multilateral institutions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America's relations with Vietnam are still overshadowed by two grave concerns.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There is uncertainty concerning Americans who became prisoners of war or were missing in action in Vietnam.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans commend President Bush for enhancing efforts to obtain the fullest possible accounting for Americans still missing in Vietnam and for the repatriation of the remains of those who died in the cause of freedom.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The government of Vietnam continues retribution against its ethnic minorities and others who fought alongside United States forces.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States owes a debt of honor to those individuals who fought alongside United States forces in Vietnam.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will not be blind to the suffering of those individuals who fought alongside United States forces in Vietnam.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
